_about: Our es/pt/de/fr for the passes, products and badges on Roblox (Roblox translates them by machine, in its own words, not like our shop). The key is the English text from monetize.py CATALOG / the badge descriptions; the product names are assembled by tools/loc_items.py from the shop translations (locales/<lang>.csv), here - only what the game does not have. Dragon names and VIP are not translated. fr: the Roblox filter rejects 'derrière toi' (derrière also means 'behind' in the rude sense) - use 'qui te suit en vol'; the non-breaking space from fr.csv is rejected too (loc_items.py replaces it with a normal one).
